name: Moths to a Flame
source:
Moths to a Flame is a horror story about six students who find themselves nose deep in a school's dark and terrible rumor.

Hal, a notorious 'non-doer'
James, his goofball best friend
Joelle, a  cheerleader with a plan
Mike, a prankster who just can't quit
Kate, a soft-spoken sweetheart
Helen, a detective of the supernatural

These six are sucked into a paranormal investigation with stakes higher than anyone could've imagined. When the rumor turns out even worse than it first seemed, they brave the depths in search of the truth.

[From [url=https://maxweil.itch.io/moths-to-a-flame]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《飞蛾扑火》讲述了六名学生发现自己深陷学校黑暗可怕谣言的恐怖故事。

哈尔，一个臭名昭著的“不行动者”
詹姆斯，他的傻瓜最好的朋友Joelle，有计划的啦啦队长
迈克，一个无法戒烟的恶作剧者
凯特，一个说话温柔的甜心
海伦，超自然侦探

这六人被卷入一项超自然现象调查，其风险超出任何人的想象。当谣言变得比最初看起来更糟糕时，他们勇敢地深入寻找真相。

[来自[url=https://maxweil.itch.io/moths-to-a-flame]Itch.io[/url]]
